name: chronicle-mcp
description: Local, private AI chat history search & memory: BM25 search over your Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT and Cline transcripts.
long_description:
Chronicle is a local stdio MCP server that imports, normalizes and indexes your AI chat transcripts (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Cline/Continue) on your own disk and serves BM25 search over them, so agents can recall past work without re-pasting it. It also ships the `start_session` and `recall_past_work` prompts and the `chronicle://capabilities` and `chronicle://chats` resources. No cloud service, account or API key: the archive and index never leave your machine.

This bundle runs the published PyPI package `chronicle-mcp-server` with `uvx`, so [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) must be installed. It needs local filesystem access and is not meant for remote hosting.

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search the local chat archive and return matching transcript chunks.

tools.name: get_chat_logs
tools.description: List archived chats, or read one chat as a message range, a short summary, or metadata.

tools.name: sync_workspace_data
tools.description: Import conversations into the archive from pasted content, a local file, or an editor's transcript folder, normalizing ChatGPT, Claude, Cline/Continue JSON, JSONL and Markdown formats.

tools.name: compile_project_insights
tools.description: Derive structured insight from archived chats: action items, a topic index, a two-chat comparison, or a Markdown project brief.

tools.name: maintain_storage
tools.description: Housekeeping for the archive: compress old chats, find or remove duplicates, change settings, or report server capabilities.

tools.name: manage_session_state
tools.description: Save, auto-save, merge, export or delete archived conversations, and watch the archive for changes.

tools.name: save_handoff_receipt
tools.description: Record what this agent run did and what the next agent must do, as a handoff receipt for the current workspace.

tools.name: get_handoff_status
tools.description: Check whether this workspace has unfinished work handed off by an earlier agent.

base_dir.title: Archive folder
base_dir.description: Folder where Chronicle keeps its chat archive and search index (sets CHRONICLE_BASE_DIR). A leading ~ is expanded to your home folder.
